title: The Relay Random Tree: A Stochastic Geometry Approach of Multihop Relay in an Urban Visibility Setting
summary: In a recent work (Lee, Baccelli $'25$), a one dimensional stochastic geometry model was introduced to study Line of Sight (LoS) connections using Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS), in the context of non terrestrial networks. In this model, signal can be propagated in a urban environment, with buildings acting as obstacles with RIS (which, for the scope of this present article can essentially be thought of as relays) on their rooftops, relaying the connection.
